scripts.check: astro check && npm test && npm run check:api
scripts.deploy:dry-run: npm run build && wrangler deploy --dry-run --config wrangler.jsonc
scripts.db:local:migrate: wrangler d1 migrations apply CMS_DB --local --config wrangler.api.jsonc
scripts.db:local:smoke: wrangler d1 execute CMS_DB --local --config wrangler.api.jsonc --command "SELECT id, status, revision FROM cms_items WHERE id = 'reference-work';"
